protocol: Matched previous two cohorts as development only. New 100 four-fixture and 100 kit episodes, 5 per BOM. Two visual models, first and overhead from same state. Old and new allocations and gates evaluated on same candidates. Primary compare revised overhead+gate at 80 and 60 to revised 100. 20 blocks of 5 per cohort; one-sided 97.5% lower paired batch t > -5pp, zero variance inconclusive; 80 before 60 per model, cohorts separate. Report first-pass endpoints including early failures. Difficulty mix and robot unchanged; four-task port is the order-selection fixture. New rules estimate net benefit by public shape family and model; additive group smoothing of strength 8, bounded pre-disagreement as tiebreaker; D-profile top reference offset follows nominal CAD. No endpoint, true pose, new cohort feedback or future optional inputs used in selection.
